whatsnew|New option to follow the Window: New option to follow the Windows main display for the captured screen.
whatsnew|Trim: Save & share now opens th: Trim: Save & share now opens the Share window.
whatsnew|Library: Share is a split butto: Library: Share is a split button. Drag and drop is the default; the other options are in its menu.
whatsnew|Recording is smoother and more: Recording is smoother and more reliable. Updates and settings import are hardened.
